evals.prompt: Analyze the website https://example.com and generate its complete design system package in ./design-systems/example-brand.
evals.expected_output: A complete design package in ./design-systems/example-brand including tokens.css, components.html, USAGE.md, design-tokens.json, components.manifest.json, and DESIGN.md (in English only) reflecting example.com's styling.

evals.prompt: Analyze the local codebase in the current folder '.' and generate a full design system package in ./design-systems/local-brand.
evals.expected_output: A complete design package in ./design-systems/local-brand including tokens.css, components.html, USAGE.md, design-tokens.json, components.manifest.json, and DESIGN.md reflecting the local UI tokens and components.

evals.prompt: Analyze the live site https://github.com and generate its structured design system package in ./design-systems/github.
evals.expected_output: A complete design package in ./design-systems/github including tokens.css, components.html, USAGE.md, design-tokens.json, components.manifest.json, and DESIGN.md capturing GitHub's branding (primer fonts, variables, etc.).
